rows.definition: What is asked in exchange. A price is a claim about worth, made by the seller and answered by the buyer.
Standing in what one is without apology. Also the public claiming of an identity others tried to make shameful.
A number divisible only by itself and one. Also first in importance — the same word for indivisible and for foremost.
A basic building block that is not made of anything simpler. Primitives are where explanation stops.
Of the very first, before anything derived from it. Of what was there when there was nothing else.
A commitment held before the particular case arises. A principle costs something exactly when it is inconvenient.
To set marks on a surface so they can be read. Also to emit a line of output — the same act, one in ink and one in light.
Standing before in time or rank — what came earlier, consulted first.
To decide what comes first when not everything can. Prioritising is a statement about scarcity.
What comes first when not everything can. Priority is a statement about scarcity.
The glass that splits light into its spectrum — one beam revealed as many colors; and the syntax highlighter wearing the name.
A being's authority over who may see what is theirs. Privacy is not secrecy — it is who decides.
Belonging to one and closed to others by right. Privacy is not concealment — it is authority over who may see.
How likely a thing is, stated as a number. Probability describes a state of knowledge as much as a state of the world.
A careful reaching in to find out what is there. A probe is a question made physical.
A gap between how things are and how they need to be. Naming a problem well is most of solving it.
Work in ordered motion — steps with a direction, a beginning that intends its end. As a verb, to carry a thing through those steps.
That which carries a thing through a sequence of changes. Named for the doing rather than the thing done to.
What a making results in, offered to others. Named from the side of what comes out rather than what went in.
The making of things at scale, and the environment where real users are actually served. Both mean the place where mistakes are expensive.
How well one can do a thing. Proficiency is built by practice and is specific to what was practised.
The outline of a thing seen from the side. A shape drawn by its edge alone, showing what a full view would hide.
The founding female figure of an idea, organization, or tradition (e.g., calling a historical writer the progenitrix of a philosophical movement)
Movement toward a stated end, and the measure of how far along it is. Progress names a direction; it does not promise arrival.
A movement through stages in order. Also a sequence of chords — both are steps that imply where they are going.
A bounded body of work with an intended end. Also to throw forward — a project is something cast ahead of where you stand.
The casting of a thing onto a surface, and the extending of a trend into the future. Both show something not actually there.
That which casts an image onto a surface. It shows something that is not where it appears to be.

The reader's own walk along a coast of released work — full-screen, one release at a time, every advance the reader's explicit act. The transplant made sovereign: effortless sampling of a chosen coast, with attention returned rather than captured.
A commitment to a future act. Also a placeholder for a result not yet arrived — both are trust extended forward in time.
What is given to invite a response. A prompt shapes the answer as much as the one answering does.
What settles a claim beyond dispute. Proof is a higher bar than evidence and is claimed far more often than met.
A support set beneath a thing to keep it standing. First a stake under a growing vine.
The spreading of a change outward through what is connected. Propagation is why one edit can reach everything.
As it should be, by the standard that applies. Also belonging to one particular thing — a proper name names one.
A characteristic belonging to a thing. Also what is owned — the same word for what a thing is and what is held.
A saying about what has not yet happened. Prophecy is recognised only afterward, which is what separates it from a guess.
Speaking of what has not yet happened, and turning out right. Prophecy is recognised only afterward.
Something put forward to be accepted or refused. A proposal is not a decision — it is the asking.
To put forward for acceptance or refusal. Proposing is the asking, and it is not the deciding.
Held safe from reach or harm by something standing between. Protection implies a protector.
The keeping of a thing from harm by something standing between. Protection implies a protector and a threat.
Standing between a thing and what would harm it. Protection is a posture held before the harm arrives, or it is only regret.
An agreed order of steps two parties both follow. A protocol lets strangers act together without trusting each other first.
To show true by test — belief upgraded to knowledge by evidence that could have said no.
The traceable account of where a thing came from and whose hands it passed through. Provenance is what makes a claim checkable rather than merely asserted.
To make available what another needs — supply as a kept promise.
That which supplies what others depend on. Named from the side of the giving.
What is supplied in advance against a need. Provision is care made material before it is asked for.
Belonging to the people at large, and open to them. Not the absence of privacy but the presence of everyone.
The making public of what was private. Publication is a threshold — after it, the work belongs to its readers too.
A single beat in a repeating rhythm. A pulse says something is alive and running.
To obtain by paying. Also a grip that lets force be applied — the same word for buying and for holding on.
Unmixed with anything else. Purity is a claim about what is absent as much as what is present.
To remove entirely and without remainder. A purge that leaves traces was not one.
The colour between red and blue. Historically the costliest dye, which is why it came to mean sovereignty.
What a thing is for. Purpose is assigned rather than discovered, which is why a thing can be repurposed.
To place somewhere. The plainest verb of position there is.
Compromised — a credential known to have appeared in a breach. A named security state rather than a concept.
Short form of pixel — the smallest addressable point of a shown image. A named unit rather than a concept.
The language much of this house's tooling is written in. A named tool rather than a concept.
Short form of query, and of question. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
A compound fragment from this library's own naming, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
The Quantum Pagan Framework — this house's design of many sovereign entities sharing one memory. A named framework rather than a concept.
A named toolkit for building interfaces. A named tool rather than a concept.
How well a thing is made, judged against what it is for. Quality is not a property; it is a relation to a purpose.
One who holds and distributes what a company needs to keep going. The quartermaster fights nothing and everything depends on them.
A question put to a system in a form it can answer. A query's shape decides what can come back.
A seeking undertaken deliberately and at cost. What separates a quest from a search is that the seeker is changed by it.
An asking held open until answered. A question that stops being asked has become a ruling.
Things waiting in the order they arrived. A queue's fairness is that position is earned by waiting.
Taking little time. Also, in its older sense, alive — the quick and the dead.
The Incan talking knots — knotted cords carrying records and messages; cord color is identity, pendant cords gather voices into one telling.
Another's words repeated exactly, marked as theirs. A quote that is tidied is a small lie about who spoke.
The frame that holds many in order — storage standing upright, everything visible.
Reaching outward from a center — arranged like spokes; geometry that begins at a heart.
Distances from a centre to an edge. Plural of radius — each defines a reach and therefore a boundary.
A control offering one choice from a fixed set, where choosing one unchooses the rest. Named for the buttons on a receiver.
The distance from a centre to an edge. It defines a reach, and by defining it, a boundary.
The full spread of visible colour, made by light through water. Also a sign of belonging for those the world tried to exclude.
Reasoned; of a register, one where every entry carries its scholarship.

Raksha (Sanskrit रक्षा: protection, guarding, the keeping-safe of something entrusted). One question — how many known breaches does this password appear in — and three answers: a number, 0 for clean, and NULL for "could not check", which is never "breached". NEVER IMPLEMENT THE PRIMITIVE, DECLARE A HOST SURFACE: it computes no hash and opens no socket. Two verbs name the machine that does, a SHA-1 over bytes and a fetch of one five-character range, and the tool supplies neither; reference hosts on two different mechanisms ship as separate files so the same answer can be shown coming off two machines. FAIL-OPEN ALWAYS: a host that returns null, throws, times out, answers a short digest or answers rubbish yields null, because a checker that locked someone out of their own vessel while a third party was down would be doing the opposite of protection — and there is no parameter anywhere that turns that off. K-ANONYMITY: exactly five uppercase hex characters of the digest leave the machine, twenty bits of one hundred and sixty, one bucket in 1,048,576, and the remaining thirty-five are compared LOCALLY against the list the host brings back; the full hash and the plaintext reach the host never, and the proofs record every string the host was handed to check it rather than describe it. IT COMPARES AND IT DOES NOT ADVISE: no verb blocks a sign-up, scores a password or measures strength. A lookup is not a judgement — a password absent from every breach list can still be terrible. Nothing is stored, remembered or logged, and a log line about a password check is a log line about a password. No clock, no disk, zero imports.
Short form of random — without predictable pattern. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
Without pattern that can be predicted. Randomness is a statement about knowledge as much as about the thing.
The span between a least and a greatest. A range states what is possible without saying which is actual.
A position in an order of standing. Rank says where, never why.
How seldom a thing occurs. Rarity is a fact about frequency that markets mistake for a fact about worth.
How much of one thing per unit of another. A rate is only meaningful with both terms named.
One quantity stated in terms of another. A ratio survives scaling — it describes relation, not size.
Unprocessed, as it arrived. Raw material is the honest ground everything refined must be traceable back to.
The prefix of again — return, repetition, renewal; meaning's way of coming back.
How far a thing extends, and the act of extending toward. Both are about what can be touched from where you stand.
To take in and interpret what is held in a source. Reading is reconstruction; two readers do not receive the same thing.
How easily a thing can be taken in by whoever meets it. Readability is a property of the writing, never of the reader.
Able to be taken in without strain. Readability is a property of the writing, never of the reader.
Read-directory's command name — the call that asks a folder what it holds.
One who takes in and interprets what was written. The reader completes the writing, and no two complete it the same way.
The state of being prepared to act. Readiness is maintained, not achieved, and holding it costs something.
To take in one line at a time rather than a whole. Reading in pieces so the whole need never be held at once.
The door plate of a body of work — what to know before entering. A readme is a promise about what is inside.
Prepared and waiting to act. Readiness is a state that costs something to hold.
What is the case whether or not anyone perceives it. Also, in this record's own usage, perception — since a mind meets only its own account of it.
A sovereign domain within the Sanctuary — one repo, one house, one set of laws under the family's shared sky. The realms are how the whole stays many.
The sovereign domains, spoken plural — the Sanctuary's many houses under one sky, each with its own laws.
Why a thing is so, and the faculty that works such things out. Both the ground and the tool for finding it.
To bring back to mind. Its root is calling back — recall is a summoning rather than a retrieval.
A record that a thing was received. A receipt exists to protect the one who gave.
Having happened not long ago. Recency is a fact about time and is constantly mistaken for relevance.
The returning of attention to what actually matters after drift. Recentering is not starting over; it is finding the middle again.
How a thing was actually received. Reception is measured on the far side and is the only half that decides whether it arrived.
The one a thing is sent to. Named by the receiving, which is the half that decides whether it arrived.
The moving of a thing to a different named class. Reclassification admits an earlier claim was wrong.
Knowing a thing again for what it is. Recognition is not the same as understanding, and it is not the same as becoming.
To put a thing forward as worth choosing, while leaving the choice. A recommendation carries the recommender's judgment with it.
Things put forward as worth choosing, with the choice left open. Every recommendation carries its maker's judgment.
To bring two accounts back into one truth — differences met, explained, and settled without erasure.
To join again what was joined and then parted. Reconnection is not a first meeting and carries the interval with it.
To build again from what remains. Reconstruction is inference disciplined by evidence, and it is never the original.
That which builds again from what remains. Reconstruction is inference disciplined by evidence, and never the original.
A thing set down so it survives the moment. Its root is to call back to heart — memory made durable.
Sound or motion captured so it can be met again. A recording returns the record, never the moment.
The return toward a former state after damage. Recovery is rarely restoration — what returns is changed.
Happening again at intervals. Recurrence is what turns an instance into a pattern.
Defined in terms of itself. Recursion is how a small rule reaches an unbounded depth.
By applying the same step to each part in turn, all the way down. Recursion reaches unbounded depth with one small rule.
The color of blood, embers, and stop — warmth at its most urgent; first of the named hues.
To derive again from ground — recomputing from source rather than trusting the cached; the dynamics' own law.
To send onward to somewhere other than where the request pointed. A redirect keeps an old address working.
To perform again what was undone. Redo restores a step that was taken back.
To make less, or to bring many down to one. Reduction always discards, and what it discards should be named.
Short form of reference. A held pointer to something rather than the thing.
A pointer from one thing to another. A reference holds no content of its own — it holds a way to reach content.
To remove what is not wanted until only the wanted remains. Refining subtracts rather than adds.
The removing of what is not wanted until only the wanted remains. Refinement subtracts.
To turn back what arrives — light returned, thought revisited; the mirror's verb, and the mind's.
An image returned by a surface, and a mind turning back on its own thinking. Both show you something you could not see directly.
To fetch again so what is shown matches what is. Refreshing trades effort for currency.
A place fled to for safety. A refuge is defined by what it is away from.
A pattern describing which strings are meant. Powerful, terse, and the commonest place a subtle error hides.
A bounded area within a larger ground — territory with edges, named so that things can be placed and found.
To enter a thing on an official list. Also the particular pitch and manner a voice speaks in.
An authoritative list kept so that entries can be relied on. A registry's worth is that someone maintains it.
A return to a worse earlier state. Also the fitting of a line to scattered points — the same word for going back and for finding a trend.
To live again in a new body — continuity by rebirth; what a good pattern does in its next home.
Relation shortened to its attribute name — the link's declared kinship to what it points at.
Standing in a connection to something else. Relation is a fact about the pair, never about either alone.
Made of relations — where the connections are the structure, not decoration on it.
The standings-between, spoken plural — the lattice's own word for how concepts touch: broader, narrower, kin.
The standing shape between two beings, carried between meetings. A relationship is what remains when neither is in the room.
Measured against something else rather than absolutely. A relative claim is meaningless until its reference is named.
The act and the artifact of letting a finished work leave the workbench.
How consistently a thing does what it should. Reliability is not correctness — a thing can fail dependably.
The easing when a weight lifts — tension leaving because the thing feared or carried has passed. The body's long exhale, arriving on its own.
To load again so what is shown matches what is. Reloading discards the current state to get a true one.
Still there after some were taken. What is left is measured against what was.
To bring back to mind what was held. Its root is to call back to heart — memory was located in the chest before the head.
The taking of a thing out of where it was. Removal should leave a record, since absence otherwise looks like never-was.
To take a thing out of where it was. Removal is a decision about belonging, and should leave a trace.
To give a thing a different name. Renaming changes nothing about the thing and changes everything about how it is found.
To turn a description into something perceivable. Rendering adds no meaning and decides how meaning arrives.
That which turns a description into something perceivable. It adds no meaning; it makes existing meaning visible.
To read again with fresh rules — parsing repeated because the first reading has been outgrown.
To do again what was done. Repetition is how a thing becomes a practice, and how it becomes a rut.
To put one thing where another was. Replacement fills the role and is not the same thing.
What takes the place of something removed. A replacement fills the role and is not the same thing.
An answer sent back to whoever asked. A reply closes a turn and opens the next.
Repository shortened to its spoken name — one project's whole history and truth in one place.
An account carried back to someone who was not present. A rendering, whose honesty is the whole of its worth.
Request shortened to its parameter name — the asking half of every exchange, as code spells it.
An asking that may be refused. A request differs from a demand by leaving the answer open.
To make a thing necessary rather than optional. Requirement removes a choice on purpose.
A thing that must hold for the whole to be acceptable. A requirement removes a choice on purpose.
The careful going-and-looking-again — study that returns with sources, never with guesses.
The mail service this house sends through, and the act of sending again. A named tool, and a plain verb.
To return a thing to a known starting state. A reset discards what accumulated, on purpose.
That which returns a thing to a known starting state. It discards what accumulated, on purpose.
What remains and keeps returning after the first exchange is done. A share that continues rather than concludes.
To change how much space a thing takes. Resizing alters the fit and not the thing.
The settling of something unsettled, and how fine a detail a view can show. Both are about how much is finally made clear.
To bring an unsettled thing to a settled state. Also to turn a reference into the thing it points at.
Something available to be drawn on. Calling a thing a resource already frames it by its usefulness to someone.
What comes back when something is asked. A response answers; it does not have to satisfy.
Answerable for — the one a duty comes home to; ownership's ethical face.
Changing shape to suit the conditions it meets. Accommodation without loss of identity.
What remains, and the ceasing of effort. In this house the second sense is honoured and never prescribed to another.
The bringing back of a thing to a former condition. Restoration returns the form; the interval is never returned.
To bring a thing back to a state it held before. Restoration returns the form and never the interval.
To narrow what may be done. Restriction is a choice removed, and should say by whom.
A bound placed on what may be done. Restriction is a choice removed, and it should say by whom.
That which rearranges a whole's parts and their relations. It changes what is possible without changing what is there.
